## Failures and reproduction rules

- approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate · clause 1: Boot stock showcase (os dev). As admin POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/remind on a pending request; read the act URL from the approver sys_notification payload.actions. Then: PUT /api/v1/approvals/act?token=TOKEN (no body). Expected per clause 1 / item title: 405 with header Allow: GET, POST. Actual: 404 application/json code ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND, no Allow header (same for DELETE, PATCH). The item's own pin packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals-act.test.ts asserts 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND for an unclaimed PUT on the dispatcher, and changeset 22578 says the self-hosted mount registers only GET and POST; the 405 belongs to the in-process ApprovalService.handleActionPage member. Disposition: assertion defect — re-word clause 1 and the item title to 405 at the member, 404 on the wire.

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps

For the wave anchor card (not extracted, not edited here).

**Checklist accuracy**
